relationships.subject: acupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Acupuncture has been shown to inhibit the activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome, reduce the release of inflammatory cytokines, alleviate inflammatory responses, and improve depressive symptoms [74].

relationships.subject: acupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistic studies demonstrate that acupuncture reverses microglial hyperactivation in chronic restraint stress (CRS) models by suppressing TLR4/MyD88 signaling and inhibiting NLRP3 inflammasome assembly.

relationships.subject: acupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: In summary, acupuncture can prevent the reduction of BDNF levels, thereby improving depressive symptoms.

key_findings: Review: acupuncture modulates central-peripheral interactions via neural circuits, neuro-immune-endocrine and humoral networks in FGIDs, depression and chronic pain.
In depression models acupuncture suppresses TLR4/MyD88-NLRP3 signaling and raises BDNF.
